name: Ashley Hornet
original_name: アシュリー・ホーネット
source:
A knight princess who is a member of the Order of the Rose Guild Alliance. Within the country, she is hailed as the strongest woman, and there is no man who doesn't know her. However, in reality, her sword skills are average. Still, her pride as a knight is exemplary. Because of her sensitive body, she doesn't like it when people touch her, and so she keeps a safe distance from them. She's called "Frozen" because of that. 

[Translated from [url=http://noblecat-soft.com/himekishiinmon/index.html#chal]Official Site[/url]]
